Don't Forget to Change your Car's Cabin Air Filter (58,000 miles on it)

I was at about 56k miles and entirely forgot about it. Mine was almost as bad as that. They want WAY too much money to do it when I can do it myself in 5 minutes. Engine intake filter is more of a PITA in my car than the cabin air.

Someone told me that it was not worth the hassle to change it. It did take me about 5 minutes to figure it out and get the filter out (very tight spot) but it was well worth it. The air quality in the car improved right away. I wonder how much a dealer would charge to do it for you?
Yeah dealer charged me $90 the first time I returned for service. When I realized how easy it was I never went back.
Jiffy Lube wants ~$45 for filter and install, I assume dealer would charge as much. Amazon sells mine for $15 dollars and will auto-ship every few months if I like.
Honestly it is worth the $45 to have clean air if you don't have the skills to do it.

Keep in mind that your ~$15 filter from Jiffy Lube and your ~$45 filter from the dealer are completely different when it comes to actual microns filtered. Even if you're going to change it yourself, I recommend buying your microfilter from the dealer. Most manufacturers recommend replacement every 1 year or 15,000 miles.
